copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 加上 Discord 机器人频道：从 channels 分支复制并注册适配器、安装 @chat-adapter/discord、构建并跑注册测试，再引导你在 Discord 开发者门户建应用、存凭证、重启服务并开通私信。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加 Discord 机器人频道时触发，例如在 /setup 流程中，或要接入 Discord 私信、服务器频道时。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 加上 Discord 频道支持
say.note: 复制并注册适配器、装依赖，然后构建和跑注册测试。

say.text: 我的 Bot Token 是 xxx，帮我存好并重启服务
帮我解析 Discord 私信频道并接通

howto.what_en: Adds Discord bot channel support to NanoClaw: copies and registers the adapter from the channels branch, installs @chat-adapter/discord, builds and runs a registration test, then guides Discord app setup, credential storage, restart, and DM setup.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Discord bot channel to NanoClaw, such as during the /setup flow or when wiring up Discord DMs or server channels.

say_en.text: Add Discord channel support to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter, installs the dependency, builds, tests.

say_en.text: Here's my Bot Token: xxx — store it and restart the service
say_en.note: Validates the token and derives App ID and public key from applications/@me.
